Selected work

Twelve briefs, twelve problems to solve.

01Personal project · Beauty

Skin Care

A promotional flyer for a beauty and skincare business selling body lotions, facial cleansers, body oils and creams. The brief was a long product list on a page that still felt premium. The amber headline leads, the model's profile points the eye toward the products, and the range sits in a dark panel that can be read in a glance.

Focus
Hierarchy, colour, product presentation
02Event promotion

Creative Connect 2026

An event flyer for Vibes Connect, a meet-up for designers, photographers, videographers and musicians in Benin City. A bold patterned frame carries the energy, a chunky title does the shouting, and the date, time and venue sit in colour blocks at the bottom so nobody misses them. Created in Photoshop to build awareness before the event on 17 October 2026.

Tool
Photoshop
03Personal practice · Fashion

Benji's Fashion

A practice concept for an agbada and native wear business. Purple was the starting decision: deep enough to feel rich, quiet enough to let embroidery detail do the selling. Oval frames pull two outfits out for a closer look, and the services list stays tidy beside the hero garments.

Tool
Photoshop
Focus
Colour, detail, audience
04Food · Promotional flyer

Gifty's Cuisine

Food flyers live or die on appetite. A deep green background makes the orange jollof tray glow, a wheel of sides shows the range without extra text, and the delivery badge, menu, phone number and address are easy to find at the bottom.

Focus
Food photography, menu layout
05Event promotion · Technology

Nexus Tech 2026

An event flyer for a one-day tech meet-up in Benin City. Two curved brackets stand in for the X in the wordmark, and the three facts people need, the date, the time and the venue, each get their own colour block: mint for when, deep blue for where. The page can be scanned in seconds.

Focus
Typography, information hierarchy
06Speaker announcement · Music

Module Five: Amakah

An announcement flyer for Class 3 of a music creation and production course, Melody and Harmony, with singer and songwriter Amakah on 9 May 2026. A postage-stamp frame and a geometric pattern give the dark top half some texture, and the green panels part around the greyscale portrait to hold the module, date and class details in a clear reading order.

Focus
Layering, colour, reading order
07Social media ad · Technology

Oraimo Headphones

A square social ad for noise-cancelling wireless headphones. The headline carries two greens, with Future in the lighter one, and a green sweep in the top corner picks up the brand colour. The headphones angle in from the lower right, and two icon-led features and a single Order Now button keep the next step obvious.

Focus
Brand colour, call to action
08Internship · Sportswear

Nike

A Nike shoe ad made during the GMC Institute internship. The oversized wordmark sits behind the trainer, and the shoe cuts across the K so the product breaks out of the type. Colour grading pulls the blurred neon background toward the purples and blues of the shoe itself.

Tool
Canva
Focus
Colour grading, depth
09Promotional flyer · Apparel

Maviclothers Monogramming

A services flyer for a sportswear and monogramming business. Three circular photo crops, monogrammed tops, embroidered caps and the embroidery machine itself, step down the page in red rings that tie back to the bold headline. Services are listed in plain type and the contact details sit right-aligned at the foot.

Focus
Photo cropping, local-business layout
10Social media · Logistics

Thobbie Distribution Network

A promo graphic for a logistics company's distribution network. Diamond frames hold the company logo and two delivery photos, leading the eye down to the headline, while the dark warehouse backdrop and teal and blue corners echo the logo. The web address and a white contact button close out the page.

Focus
Shape-led layout, brand colour
11Logo design

FARP

A logo built around growth: a rising arrow cuts through three bars, held inside a crescent, with a thin divider before the wordmark. White on near-black keeps it simple enough to hold up at small sizes.

Focus
Symbol design, simplicity
12Logo design

Create Mode

A logo for a creative brand: a pen nib takes the place of a letter in Create, and an open book sits inside the O of Mode, all wrapped in a ring. It comes as a full-colour version in indigo and gold and a one-colour black version for stamps, print and single-colour uses.

Focus
Symbol design, colour variants

Design in motion

Then I make them move.

Flyer animations and motion graphics. They play quietly as you scroll to them; use the controls for the full video with sound.

About

Looking good is the easy part.

I'm Tobi, a graphic designer in Lagos with over a year of working experience. I make promotional graphics, social media campaigns, marketing materials and brand identities, and I animate them when the idea needs it.

I've designed for fashion, logistics, technology, food, finance, healthcare, beauty and creative events. Every brief teaches me to ask the same questions first: who is this for, and what should they remember? Then composition, typography and colour have a job to do.

I'm still growing, and I like it that way. I follow brand guidelines closely, I notice small details, and I'm happiest when a static design gets a second life in After Effects.
